name: security-kubernetes-admission-webhook-review
intent: Admission webhook selection, authentication and failure behavior
artifacts: Webhook configuration, rules/selectors/match policy, timeout/failure policy and admitted object.
trace: Determine which operations/resources reach the webhook and whether equivalent API paths or webhook failures admit an object violating the intended invariant.
experiment: Use an isolated cluster fixture with inert pods/config and compare compliant object, policy violation and controlled webhook unavailability.
disproof: A fail-open setting is not a demonstrated dangerous admission without an in-scope violated workload policy; an excluded object may be intentional.
repair: Align matching and failure behavior with the enforced invariant and retest availability recovery and legitimate admissions.
branch_decisions: Resolve webhook rules, namespace/object selectors, match conditions, failurePolicy and reinvocation behavior for the actual API operation. A fail-open timeout is material only when a required admission restriction is thereby skipped. Operator-supplied webhook configuration is privileged setup; do not label that setup itself an unprivileged bypass or cause production timeouts.
